people.name: Galilee
people.line: Region in northern Israel; key location in Jesus' ministry

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Philip
people.line: One of the twelve apostles of Jesus

translations.web: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”
translations.bsb: The next day Jesus decided to set out for Galilee. Finding Philip, He told him, “Follow Me.”
translations.kjv: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.
translations.asv: On the morrow he was minded to go forth into Galilee, and he findeth Philip: and Jesus saith unto him, Follow me.
